criteria.reason: Passing, no-summary, no --dir, repo and FS-5 runs each print one JSON line (lines=1), exit=0, PARSE_OK with keys ok,noCi,workflows,checks,gaps,unclear and check keys summary,docsRecordSkip,recordCommitSkip; every status is pass/gap/unclear with a detail.
Run with no --dir from a temp dir holding .github/workflows/passing.yml: workflows = ["passing.yml"].

ok and the unclear case behave as stated (all-pass ok:true with empty lists; unclear run ok:false with one unclear entry per check). But a gap check does not appear once in gaps: on this repo's ci.yml (ci-baseline-cli-transcript.txt, FS-4 section) gaps holds 11 entries, docsRecordSkip and recordCommitSkip five times each (one per job), where the definition expects one entry per check (three). The TRD's line 6 only says gaps: [{check, message}], so the fix may be to collapse entries per check in the library or to correct the definition's 'once'.
Read-only run on the repo's .github/workflows: summary, docsRecordSkip, recordCommitSkip all gap, ok:false.
FS-5a: passing.yaml (read as .yaml) plus deploy.yml on push to main gives all three pass; FS-5b: same deploy on push with no branches gives docsRecordSkip gap naming deploy.yml job deploy.
Jest 'fixtures passing: ok with no gaps or unclear' passes (45/45); CLI on the passing fixture prints ok:true, all pass, empty gaps and unclear.
Jest no-summary case passes; CLI on no-summary fixture: gaps holds exactly one entry, check=summary, docsRecordSkip and recordCommitSkip pass.
Four variants (no always()/!cancelled(), needs omits test, no needs-result read, trigger-level paths) each give checks.summary.status=gap.
needs.*.result, needs.<job>.result, toJSON(needs) and an alls-green step each give checks.summary.status=pass.

The claimed artifact is substituted (skill text plus CLI detail), but the live ship-setup readout in it1-run1-transcript.txt carries 'Record commits must never carry [skip ci], because that skips every workflow, including the summary job.' (run 2 repeats it).
No change-detection job and no heavy if: summary pass, gaps holds exactly the docsRecordSkip and recordCommitSkip entries, docsRecordSkip detail names job test; Jest no-path-filter case passes.
Unrecognised if: form, file-path filters, predicate-quantifier every and a run: detector each give docsRecordSkip unclear with an unclear entry naming job test.
second.yml with trigger paths-ignore beside the passing ci.yml: docsRecordSkip gap naming the trigger-level filter.

Passing workflow plus event-scoped deploy job gives docsRecordSkip pass (summary and change-detection jobs also cause no gap); the Jest case 'event-scoped deploy job is excluded, not unclear' passes. The variant's YAML was not retained, so the deploy job's presence rests on the Jest case and the exerciser's account.
matchesFilter tests pass (any-pattern, negation, dotfile); filter ['**','!docs/**','!**/*.md'] gives docsRecordSkip gap, filter ['src/**'] gives docsRecordSkip and recordCommitSkip pass.
API-mode dorny on pull_request: docsRecordSkip pass, recordCommitSkip gap, gapChecks exactly [recordCommitSkip]; Jest full-suite case passes.
run: detector with before+.trd-state gives recordCommitSkip pass; before only gives unclear; neither gives unclear.
Push-triggered API-mode dorny: filter src/** gives recordCommitSkip pass, filter ** gives recordCommitSkip gap, matching docsRecordSkip each time.
Job gated on !contains(head_commit.message,'record'): reported unclear as an unrecognised form; neither docsRecordSkip nor recordCommitSkip is pass.
Library loads (exit 0); probes match the fixed lists; isRecordFile true for the three record probes, false for the docs probes; Jest probe tests pass.
Live /ship-setup session in a fixture slot ran node .claude/lib/ci-baseline.js check; its JSON output ({"ok":false,...}) fed the readout. Driven by the exerciser in tmux, not Forge.

Run 1 (copied ci.yml) ISSUES names the missing summary job, the docs/record-only runs and the record-commit re-runs, each with a fix; run 2 adds 'Not checked: the build job in filters.yml' for the file-path filter, with how to make it checkable.
STATE carries 'CI baseline: 0 of 3 checks hold for ci.yml.'

The yes case is proven: only ship.md modified and ensemble-ship-resume.yml added, ci.yml and filters.yml sha256 unchanged.
